Company_Code.description: Valid Company in Spectrum. Defaults from the Authorization ID if not populated

Subcontract_Number.description: No duplicate combination of Vendor and Subcontract number.

Job_Number.description: Jobs - Required for new record only. The Job cannot be changed on an existing Subcontract

Status_Code.description: (A)ctive, (I)nactive or (C)omplete. If blank then default to Active when creating a new record.

Insurance_Cert_Flag.description: (Y)es, (N)o or (A)for not applicable. Defaults from Vendor if blank.

Date_Issued.description: Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to current processing date if blank.

Contact_Person.description: Not part of the Contact Master in Spectrum.

Unit_Price_Flag.description: (Y)es or (N)o. Defaults as yes if Unit Price Job. Defaults to N if blank.

GL_Account.description: G/L Master File Maintenance - Required when creating a new Subcontract. The GL Account code must be a direct Job cost account.

Retention_Percent.description: Enter 10.2% as 10.2. Positive numbers only. Format = 2.1

Next_Payment_Number.description: Positive numbers only. Defaults to 1 if adding a new subcontract.

Pay_Override.description: Enter (Y)es to override. Defaults to N if blank.

Pay_Terms.description: Defaults from Vendor, if Pay_Override is not a Y - Enter 'A' if based on invoice date. Enter 'B' if based on 1st of next month.

Pay_Days.description: Defaults from Vendor, if Pay_Override is not a Y - Positive numbers only.

Disc_Override.description: Enter (Y)es to override. Defaults to N if blank.

Disc_Terms.description: Defaults from Vendor, if Disc_Override is not a Y - Enter 'A' if based on invoice date. Enter 'B' if based on 1st of next month.

Disc_Days.description: Defaults from Vendor, if Disc_Override is not a Y - Positive numbers only.

Disc_Perc.description: Defaults from Vendor, if Disc_Override is not a Y- Enter 10.25% as 10.25. Positive numbers only.

Pay_When_Paid.description: Pay_Override field must be defined as Y to change this field to Yes - Enter (Y)es or (N)o. Defaults to N if blank.
